tool_plan.objective: Generate representative Chrome web-cache content and preserve the Chrome Cache_Data artifact that ChromeCacheView can list, export, preview, and extract.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Launch Chrome with a controlled profile to create cache evidence.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Discover visible controls and meaningful navigation or form effects.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Request distinct documents and resources that populate the Chrome cache.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Submit realistic search or form input that produces parameterized cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Commit discovered controls and exercise resulting page or resource requests.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Vary observed finite parameters before committing a compatible form or view change.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveal lazy-loaded or progressive resources that may be cached.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserve a visible representation of content associated with generated cache activity.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Close the browser after activity so pending cache data is flushed for collection.

completion.detail: Complete only after Chrome has been closed and the collected profile contains the chromium.cache.cache_data artifact.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chrome using the controlled profile. Use runtime-provided relevant navigation targets with browser.goto to load a few distinct, content-rich pages that naturally request documents, images, scripts, and other cacheable resources. On each visible page, use browser.get_clickables to observe available controls; where additional content is visibility-bounded, use a bounded observe -> browser.scroll or compatible browser.select_option/browser.click -> re-observe loop to reveal and request progressive or lazy-loaded resources. Use browser.smart_type only with visible search or form fields, then commit using an appropriate discovered browser.click or compatible browser.select_option so parameterized responses and associated resources are requested. Capture browser.screenshot while representative loaded content is visible. Close Chrome with browser.close to flush pending cache writes, producing chromium.cache.cache_data.
